# Register of information: ICT third-party arrangements

Owner: Example Ltd, Head of Technology Risk
Last reviewed: 2026-10-01

One row per contractual arrangement with an ICT third-party service provider (Article 28).

| Provider | Service | Function supported | Critical or important | Contract reference | Country of service | Exit plan reference |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Northwind Hosting BV | Cloud hosting | Payment processing | Critical | CT-2024-017 | Netherlands | docs/exit-plan.md |
| Contoso Mail Services | Email delivery | Customer notices | Important | CT-2023-044 | Ireland | docs/exit-plan.md |

## Keeping the register current

- Add a row when a new arrangement is signed and update it when a contract, service or location changes.
- Review the whole register at least once a year and record the date above: 2026-10-01
- Mark each function as critical or important with the reason: payment processing is critical because customers cannot pay without it.
- Link every critical or important row to its exit plan: see docs/exit-plan.md.
